[ "$(jq -r '"'.blocked|length' .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json)\" = 0 ]
[ \""'$(jq -r '"'.unresolved_external|length' .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json)\" = 0 ]
echo 'coverage_valid=true'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '.entity_repairs |= map(.evidence = (.evidence | add))' .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json > /tmp/completion-fixed.json && mv /tmp/completion-fixed.json .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json
jq empty .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json
jq -e '
  (.selected_rules|type)==\"array\" and
  (.entity_repairs|type)==\"array\" and

    (.entities|type)==\"array\" and (.entities|length)>0 and
    ([.entities[]|type] | all(.==\"string\")) and
    (.evidence|type)==\"array\" and (.evidence|length)>0 and
    ([.evidence[]|type] | all(.==\"string\")) and
    (.transformation|type)==\"string\" and (.transformation|length)>0 and
    .status==\"repaired\"
  ] | all)
' .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json >/dev/null
echo 'schema_equivalent_valid=true'
printf 'evidence_types='; jq -r '[.entity_repairs[].evidence[]|type]|unique|join(\",\")' .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json
printf 'reported_locations='; jq '[.entity_repairs[].locations[]]|length' .exp_agent/round_02/completion.json
